+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in stderr with their decoded text."""
+    lines = stderr.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    output: list[bytes] = []
+    index = 0
+
+    while index < len(lines):
+        line = lines[index]
+        header = line.rstrip(b"\r\n") in (b"#< CLIXML", b"CLIXML")
+        if not header:
+            output.append(line)
+            index += 1
+            continue
+
+        # CLIXML is emitted as a header line followed by one or more XML lines.
+        content = b"".join(lines[index + 1:])
+        end = content.find(b"</Objs>")
+        if end == -1:
+            output.extend(lines[index:])
+            break
+
+        end += len(b"</Objs>")
+        block_bytes = line + content[:end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                parse_input = block_bytes.decode("utf-8").encode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                parse_input = block_bytes.decode("cp437").encode("utf-8")
+            replacement = _parse_clixml(parse_input)
+        except Exception:
+            output.append(line)
+            index += 1
+            continue
+
+        output.append(replacement)
+        remainder = content[end:]
+        if remainder:
+            # The closing tag may be followed by ordinary stderr on its line.
+            output.append(remainder)
+        consumed = len(content[:end])
+        consumed_lines = 0
+        seen = 0
+        for following in lines[index + 1:]:
+            if seen >= consumed:
+                break
+            seen += len(following)
+            consumed_lines += 1
+        index += 1 + consumed_lines
+
+    return b"".join(output)
+
